title: Short Dramas are Big Business in China - The Wire China
gist: Paywalled teaser arguing short (micro) dramas are big business in China; the only substantive detail is that production houses now use AI post-production plus overseas translation and distribution.

insights.claim: Chinese micro-drama production companies, such as one in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, run workflows combining script refinement, AI post-production, and translation and distribution for overseas markets.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Signals generative AI cutting content costs and Chinese short-drama formats being exported abroad; watch short-drama apps and platforms.
insights.quote: script refinement, AI post-production, and overseas translation and distribution
insights.locator: Staff members work on script refinement

insights.claim: Short dramas, built on melodramatic plots such as revenge and reincarnation stories, have become big business in China.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Short-form paid video is a consumer-content growth niche in China worth tracking.
